title: [Run] Crash (`COMException`) when trying drag and drop when other DnD is already in progress
author: FWest98

judgment.rationale: The report provides deterministic steps and a complete COMException stack showing PowerToys Run starts OLE drag-and-drop while another drag operation is already active. The failure path is specific enough for a bounded defensive fix.
evidence: Starting a long drag operation and then dragging a Run result reliably raises `A drag operation is already in progress`.
The stack reaches `PowerLauncher.MainWindow.SuggestionsList_MouseMove` through WPF DragDrop.DoDragDrop.
A public comment explains that Windows drag-and-drop is normally synchronous and discusses asynchronous shell support.
The issue is labeled Priority-1 and Product-PowerToys Run.
judgment.recommended_action: Queue a PowerToys Run design to reject or safely handle a concurrent OLE drag operation without crashing.

fix_assessment.rationale: The exception boundary is known; implementation should guard/catch the specific concurrent-drag failure and restore UI state, with async drag considered only if justified.

issue_context.summary: PowerToys Run crashes when a result drag starts while another Windows drag-and-drop operation is already in progress.
known_information: The thrown exception is a COMException from WPF/OLE DoDragDrop.
The trigger is a concurrent long-running drag.
The Run mouse-move handler initiates the failing operation.
inferences: A narrow concurrent-drag guard is lower risk than introducing asynchronous shell drag-and-drop.
issue_context.analysis: The public stack and deterministic reproduction make this immediately designable at the exception boundary.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the current public issue body, labels, assignees, and up to the latest 20 public comments returned by GitHub.
Kept the existing dashboard read-only; no dashboard files were modified or published.

actions.label: Queue concurrent drag guard
actions.note: Draft candidate only; no comment or other write was made to microsoft/PowerToys.

comment.body: The supplied stack and reproduction identify a narrow failure boundary: `SuggestionsList_MouseMove` calls WPF/OLE `DoDragDrop` while another drag is active, raising `A drag operation is already in progress`. The fix should prevent that specific COMException from terminating PowerToys Run, restore drag/UI state, and include a regression test or manual case with a long external drag already active.
